name: Icinga Web 2
description: Web interface for Icinga 2 showing host and service status, monitoring history, and configuration.

envVars.description: Password for the Icinga Web 2 MySQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mysql"
      DB_NAME: icingaweb2
      DB_USER: icingaweb2
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      ICINGAWEB_ADMIN_PASS: {{env.ICINGAWEB_ADMIN_PASS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/data/etc/icingaweb2
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: icingaweb2
      MYSQL_USER: icingaweb2
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
